messages:
sara - design: dropped a compact v1 for the rotate scheduling modal + small empty-keys hint. Need quick copy + accessibility sanity check. figma: https://figma.com/file/rotate-sched-ux

noah - eng: backend supports immediate, delay presets (10m/1h/24h) and custom ISO timestamps. two asks: (1) always surface timezone, (2) for scheduled rotations return schedule_at in ISO with tz so UI can show both local + UTC.

ivy - ux: +1 on timezone. microcopy suggestion for the top explainer: "Rotate issues a new key and keeps the old key active for a short undo window unless you choose immediate revoke." short and scannable.

pavel - product: small wording tweak: prefer "undo window" over "grace period" in UI copy. Ops folk said "undo" is clearer. Can we also show the numeric window (e.g., 15 minutes) and link to org settings?

sara - design: will swap to "undo window" and add the link. proposing a pill: "Undo window: 15 minutes (org override)". Also thinking about CTAs: show "Rotate key now" when immediate, "Schedule rotation" for delayed flows.

noah - eng: permission nuance: users without key.manage should see "Request rotation" not disabled CTA. That opens a small prefilled request modal with key id and suggested text. API: POST /v1/requests {type: "rotation", key_id, reason}

ivy - ux: accessibility: modal must be role=alertdialog and keyboard-trap. focus order: title -> explainer -> schedule -> reason -> primary -> cancel. Also ensure aria-describedby for permission tooltip.

pavel - product: copy for the permission tooltip: "Requires key.manage. Request access to rotate this key." keep short. Also, in the modal show last 3 recent clients (names only) so users can assess impact.

sara - design: recent clients section will be collapsible by default. backend returns up to 3 clients: client_id + display_name + last_seen. we won't show IPs.

noah - eng: we can return last_clients limited to 3. performance OK. small API example for schedule + notify:

```
POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate
{
  "schedule_at": "2026-06-01T14:00:00-07:00",
  "notify": true
}
```

ivy - ux: toast/live-region behavior: success message should use aria-live=polite for non-blocking and assertive for failures. make sure the live region exists before modal closes, otherwise VoiceOver misses it. Also prefer inline confirmation near the key row after modal closes (persist 5s).

pavel - product: empty-keys copy idea: "No active API credentials — create a scoped key to get started." beneath that a collapsed checklist: Who can create keys, Set rotation policy, Audit logs. Also quick actions: Create API key / Set rotation (30d).

sara - design: will add the collapsed checklist and quick Set rotation prefill. Also color/accessibility note: status chips should have icon + label, not color-only.

noah - eng: localization: avoid shorthand like "1h" in UI, use localized strings ("1 hour"). Also schedule preview should show both local tz and UTC like: "2026-06-01 14:00 (PDT) / 2026-06-01 21:00 UTC".

ivy - ux: copy nits for the CTA: immediate button "Rotate key now" (primary) and a secondary "Rotate and revoke old key" option for advanced users. but keep revoke as a separate explicit flow elsewhere to avoid mistakes.

pavel - product: good call to separate revoke. Add a one-line link in rotate modal to "What's the difference between rotate and revoke?" that expands a short paragraph. users keep mixing them up.

sara - design: final asks before I push v2: confirm undo window value (ops?), exact permission tooltip copy, and if we want an API-snippet chevron in the modal.

noah - eng: ops: rotation.undo_seconds default=900 (15m). can be overridden per org. permission tooltip copy OK as pavel wrote. API snippet chevron = yes.

ivy - ux: no blockers from UX. I'll follow up with microcopy variants in a quick thread.

alerts-bot: reminder: design review scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
